checkpoint_policy: Seven latest complete operator-split macrostates at or before force-uniform targets in each of (i) the final 30% window and (ii) the full anytime window from the first algorithm-produced macrostate, including the endpoint.
barrier_protocol: Real OpenMM Cartesian-linear 10/20 subdivisions per segment; 40/80 while successive barriers differ by >0.05 kcal/mol.
